phases.objective: Expose a disabled-by-default Streamable HTTP MCP read-only slice whose initialization, tool discovery, authentication challenge, workspace isolation, and Brand isolation can be executed end to end in a synthetic runtime.

e2e_journeys.actor: ChatGPT-compatible MCP client using a controlled authenticated principal
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /mcp initialize, tools/list, and tools/call requests plus host-bound protected-resource metadata discovery
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The client receives a bounded read-only catalog, authorized workspace and Brand results, neutral denial for inaccessible workspaces, and no secrets or mutation capability.
steps: Initialize the feature-flagged MCP runtime using supported JSON-RPC and protocol headers.
Discover the focused read-only workspace and Brand tools with OAuth scope metadata and accurate safety annotations.
Invoke protected tools without authentication and receive an MCP authentication challenge without data disclosure.
Invoke workspace and Brand tools with a controlled authenticated principal and resolve only active memberships and effective Brand grants.
Route protected-resource metadata by request host so the Activation resource contract remains unchanged and the disabled MCP host fails closed.
assertions: The new MCP route is disabled by default and accepts no query-string credential contract.
Every advertised tool is read-only, non-destructive, closed-world, and independently bounded.
A workspace identifier is a selector and an inaccessible workspace returns MCP_CONTEXT_DENIED without identifier leakage.
The MCP metadata host returns the configured MCP resource while the Activation host preserves its existing resource metadata.
Tool results and metadata contain no access token, provider credential, raw grant, or write capability.

phases.objective: Add production-grade OAuth authorization-server conformance, resource-bound token validation, operational controls, bounded failure handling, and live developer-mode acceptance.
Prove token revocation, dependency fault handling, retry classification, metadata drift detection, and recovery without cross-tenant leakage.
Validate the exact candidate against a public non-production MCP endpoint with MCP Inspector and ChatGPT Developer mode readback.
Verify exact Production SHA, runtime metadata parity, OAuth linkage, tenant isolation, revocation, monitoring, and rollback evidence.
